## D-199 - Clean filing section boundaries and read proved foreign notes (2026-11-04)

The final50 database and the independent audit's cached SEC responses were replayed offline. The database is opened only with `new Database(path, { readonly: true, fileMustExist: true })`. No owner settings, credentials, live application database, live SEC endpoint, paid provider or model is accessed. Real filing text, the complete before/after ledgers, source hashes and measurement scripts remain in gitignored `tmp/section-boundaries/` and `tmp/section-review-followup/`; committed tests use synthetic markup.

### Final section identity and boundary rule

Apply these in order: (1) prove the substantive notes opening and return notes only; (2) if the notes opening cannot be proved, retain the established, substantive and bounded financial-statement Item 1, Item 8 or same-document Item 18, labelled **financial statements and notes**; (3) keep a specific gap only when neither interval is established. A successful legacy redirect alone is insufficient proof of the complete financial item: a fragment starting in a later note cannot be relabelled as that item. Short references, metadata and contents-only starts do not prove substantive bodies.

The legacy grammar previously missed Consolidated Condensed word order, Interim/Unaudited qualifiers, inline font splits, unnumbered first subsections and longer notes introductions. Recovery now uses visible, unlinked, standalone original source blocks and exact following text to map an opening into the existing item without reformatting it. A real first-note body can follow a complete notes contents list without repeating the notes title. Contents/page sequences and statement references remain rejected. Existing successful recognition paths win, preserving their exact bytes. All eight reviewed domestic slots recover substantive notes-only openings; none needs the combined-item fallback.

All paths share the established audit/review, signature and subsequent-section stops. A leading annual audit report can be excluded only when an original standalone financial-statement caption proves where the financial body resumes. Original source blocks prove glossary, management, schedules, supplemental-information and later-item boundaries; links and repeated current-item page headers do not close notes. An advancing numbered note after an unnumbered caption keeps a genuine note subsection inside the interval, preserving PG. Header item extraction requires a next-item boundary and never substitutes window/document end. No ticker-specific dispatch is used.

Both foreign notes success routes also pass through the same original-source heading stops with logical Item 18 context, including a real later Item 19. Annual index redirects carry the enclosing Item 8 or Item 15 proved around their index; an index without that authority retains its closed page/appendix proof without guessing Item 8. Repeated Item 15 captions in the financial appendix do not create another index authority or close the notes. The printed-page index route likewise excludes current-item and explicitly continued item captions from its end candidates. Actual later items and standalone supplemental, glossary and management sections still close notes; genuine note subsections followed by advancing notes remain inside them.

The optional combined-scope field reaches payload titles, excerpt source tags, governance citations and deterministic filing-fact source tags. A citation says financial statements and notes when that is the retained interval. Actual 10-K/10-Q/20-F provenance is kept. The optional field is backward compatible; stored reports are not rewritten. Existing domestic/IFRS numeric guards are unchanged.

The blanket 20-F refusal is removed. Same-primary notes need a proved opening and either a closed financial item or the original financial-index/page proof. Linked targets must be unique, visible and on the referenced page; intervening printed pages must be consecutive and closed, with no unnumbered physical page or visible material after the final proved page. Separately incorporated documents require the filing's own explicit, unique annual-report exhibit reference and complete proof in that document.

## D-204 - Unknown tickers, regulated utilities, foreign financials and independent beta (2026-11-04)

**Boundary and evidence.** This work changes instrument/job admission, the
regulated-utility valuation rule, foreign financial valuation and beta selection.
Lease/debt, revenue admission and economic share-class implementations are
outside this change. Frozen `app-data-round2/live.db` is opened read-only with
`fileMustExist: true`; source snapshots and saved reports stay immutable. The
inventory includes 104 attempted company symbols (including unknown ZZZZQ) plus
the QQQ ETF control. No live FMP, Finnhub, FRED or model call is made. No owner's
environment, credential or application database is read.

**Unknown tickers.** The runner classified a missing profile as unconfirmed, then
explicitly persisted a completed data-only report if nothing analyzable existed.
Remove that exception: every unsupported/unconfirmed instrument ends
`unsupported`, saves no report and stops before model resolution, payload
assembly, pass preflight, paid lease and provider-model request admission.
Affirmative empty profile results, or a missing key plus a confirmed SEC ticker
table miss, say the ticker was not found and may be invalid or delisted.
Transport failure alone only leaves classification unestablished. An unknown
symbol ending in Q is not assumed delisted from its spelling. Malformed symbols
stop before data acquisition, including a company-shaped injected bundle. ETF
and fund refusals retain their existing typed reason. Supported-company
data-only reports remain available.

**Regulated utilities.** The existing overlay already requires utility SIC and
recent filed regulatory assets or regulated revenue. Use that proved overlay,
including transmission/distribution SIC 4922 and 4923 alongside 4911, 4924, 4931,
4932 and 4941. Keep its 24-month and filed-by-cutoff rules. SIC alone is not
enough: an independent power producer without regulation evidence stays on the
general route. No industry-name shortcut or issuer exception is added.

The owner's methodology decision is to treat these utilities like equity REITs
for intrinsic valuation. A regulated utility funds large capex with external
capital earning an allowed return; this FCFF model does not represent the
rate-base funding cycle. Withhold per-share FCFF, reverse DCF, grids and DCF
scenario targets with that reason. Retain P/E, dividend yield, EV/EBITDA and
available peer context. Do not fabricate a rate-base model or change the
Moody's credit calculation. Valuation can still use available own-history
multiple ranks. Without them its score is null, with the existing neutral
composite treatment; the report prints D-201's note that the missing valuation
weight counts as neutral and can raise or lower the composite. That is not an
improvement in the investment conclusion.

**Foreign financials.** D-178's monetary translator already includes the
excess-return operands. Acquisition also already retains CAD/GBP H.10 rates.
The blockers are security evidence and a headline that discards the specific
conversion refusal. Permit an explicitly non-ADR, independently corroborated
one-for-one ordinary listing through the same SEC identity, two-count, 1%,
dated capitalization, split and class guards. Label its evidence `ordinary`.
It cannot admit a non-unit ratio or an unknown listing type. ADS rules are
unchanged. Convert book, alternative book, preferred/convertible claims and
debt at the same dated rate; share and conversion units use the same proved
ratio. ROTE/ROE and payout remain ratios of matching native-currency amounts;
the financial route discounts USD equity cash flows at USD cost of equity and
uses no WACC. P/TBV, reverse valuation and scenario inputs share this basis.
Refusals now carry the specific missing FX or security evidence into the
financial fair-value headline. No stale-rate or ratio tolerance is relaxed.

**Independent beta.** A plausible provider raw beta in (0, 4] remains unchanged.
Only a missing or implausible beta may use the retained issuer/SPY monthly OLS.
Require the existing 24-return floor, real ordered dates before the analysis
day, a slope in (0, 4], finite R² in (0, 1], nonnegative finite standard error,
and slope greater than 2.1 standard errors. This house admission bar exceeds
the two-sided 95% t critical value at the minimum 22 residual degrees of freedom;
it assesses the evidence for a positive market sensitivity, not the proportion
of business risk explained by SPY. Retain the estimator's 60-month, completed-
month and common-price-basis rules and the existing Blume adjustment/clamps.
The source and warning name the refused provider value, slope, window, count,
price basis, R² and standard error. An unusable regression still refuses.

BP's retained slope 0.169952 with SE 0.235573 (R² 0.009049) and SHEL's 0.082718
with SE 0.184809 (R² 0.003502), each from 59 returns, do not pass. Both stay
withheld for a stated weak regression, rather than accepting a positive but
uninformative slope. TM's ordinary/quoted count ratio and BABA's unresolved
split evidence remain the D-196 refusals; no FX or beta change repairs those
security defects.

**Tests and release boundary.** Failing synthetic regressions precede changes
for unknown/outage/delisted-style jobs, malformed symbols, utility admission and
FCFF/target suppression, ordinary quoted units, bank refusal provenance, and
beta fit/date fallback. Negative controls preserve supported companies, typed
ETFs/funds, unregulated generators, non-unit ordinary listings, disputed/missing
counts and rates, weak/short/future regressions, and plausible provider betas.
CAD/GBP acquisition doubles retain the rate and agree with serialized frozen
replay on fair value, targets and composite; no live provider refresh is claimed.
Utility report assembly retains current multiples and prints the refusal and
D-201 note. Before release, advance Stage B implementation, fair-value method,
scenario-target method, payload and pipeline orchestration stamps together.
No report-schema or score-band change is required. No version constants are
changed here and no stored report is recalculated.

## D-202 - Lease and debt admission beyond the test panel (2026-11-04)

(Revised by D-250: rule 1's "a disclosed but incomplete family still refuses an
unsupported total" now also holds for a provider row whose filing tags one
finance-lease maturity only, so RIVN's 2026 quarter-end totals are withheld
where this entry lists RIVN as unchanged; and an undisclosed provider lease
zero on an unclassified balance sheet is completed from the one filing, so O's
2026-09-30 debt is a number.)

Implementation commits: `6e825122` and `979e3e73` on
`t3/balance-round2-fix`, based on `e6110f17`.

The default model excludes operating leases from financing debt and retains
finance leases. D-196's requirement for separate filings of both lease families
was too strict for an undisclosed vendor lease zero: reconciled borrowing
components establish their scope independently of that line. The calculation
view composes the proved amounts once, then applies the same lease treatment
to net debt, WACC and invested capital. No valuation coefficient is calibrated.

### Admission rules and root causes

1. **Undisclosed finance leases.** If no recognized separate finance-liability
   element is filed at the instant, assume that family is not separately
   material under ASC 842. State the assumption, never call it a filed zero,
   and do not attach finance-liability provenance to it. An actually disclosed
   finance total is used; its maturity split is required only where an overlap
   calculation needs that split. A disclosed but incomplete family still
   refuses an unsupported total. Vendor borrowing components, total and
   embedded operating portions must reconcile in one filing and currency.
2. **Operating-only vendor lines.** A vendor line equal to a complete filed
   operating liability is operating-only. It need not equal operating plus
   finance liabilities. The separate finance observation stays available on
   both conventions, including the equity-bridge explanation. Retain all
   negative-input and total-debt checks. A filed combined lease line, a missing
   or different instant, or an unproved operating scope cannot use this rule.
3. **Partial operating leases and zero borrowings.** Where one filing proves
   the retained composition, the disclosed noncurrent operating portion can
   cancel without inventing its current maturity. Full lease-inclusive debt
   remains unavailable. Retained vendor zero borrowings with no contradictory
   recognized borrowing disclosure are labelled vendor observations, not
   filed zeros. This fixes the cause of T/PLTR's missing debt operand;
   independent security/class or valuation-domain guards remain authoritative.
   Without separate finance-liability disclosure, combined current maturities
   plus separately disclosed short-term borrowing can establish current debt
   when the vendor amount reconciles: RTX's 5,679M + 210M = 5,889M current
   borrowing is established. Its latest vendor component sum is
   5,889M + 31,490M + 1,495M = 38,874M, versus the supplied 38,884M. Under
   the final materiality rule below, the 0.025718% difference is qualified and
   the reconciled components are used; the unexplained 10M is never inserted
   as a balancing plug or described as filed equality. A separately
   filed finance family or competing inclusive current total still leaves an
   overlap without pure maturities unresolved. IBM's vendor total agrees with
   its own components, but the overlap of current borrowing tags is unresolved
   by the debt reader. Its retained statement interval is only 18 characters
   of contents-page residue. The follow-up below distinguishes that extractor
   gap from the substantive borrowing disclosure already present in its notes.
   HOOD's 2025 vendor current debt is 11,626M
   beside zero filed noncurrent debt and no compatible current borrowing
   observation; it cannot be treated as proved borrowing merely by repairing
   the zero lease line. Its annual debt/WACC refusal remains.
4. **Gross versus carrying debt.** AVGO's August 2026 same-filing combined
   gross amount 61,079M plus the signed discount/issuance-cost amount -1,660M
   equals inclusive carrying debt 59,419M: current 2,252M plus noncurrent
   57,167M. At November 2025, 67,120M - 1,984M = 65,136M. The old completeness
   check called those costs missing borrowings. Exempt only that proved gross
   observation; an incorrect sign, unmatched amount, different filing or issuer
   still refuses. No principal amount replaces carrying debt.
5. **Unclassified leases in the interest test.** INFY's vendor debt has an
   unclassified lease component. The completeness test dropped that entire
   component while retaining its interest, then reported a 33.3% implied rate
   on the small remaining borrowing balance. Retain a reconciled published
   total in this test when neither lease family is classified. A proved
   operating portion still leaves the interest-bearing denominator; the
   implausible-rate and unexplained-collapse controls remain. No FX, ADR,
   beta, utility routing, revenue or share-class rule is changed here.
6. **Cash and filing order.** A cash-driven net-debt refusal prevented debt
   completion when cash admission ran first, although the same debt completed
   when debt ran first. Reconcile debt independently and preserve the cash/net
   refusal, including a snapshot carrying an older debt refusal. Prefer the
   vendor row's original filing for debt completion; a later partial
   comparative must not replace the complete original in replay while
   acquisition retains it. Missing/refused invested-capital operands are
   named and never zero-filled, even when an audit observation remains numeric.

### Materiality follow-up: final vendor-total rule (2026-11-04)

Implementation: `7c48c3125546e93c3bc9fccb6d7fe5ea073ae357` and
`18ea3137b97cc73230ccc78133fdf240d95b6370` on the same branch.

The preceding 23-company table and preservation proof are the initial D-202
result at `6ac103b9`. This follow-up compares against that result, not against
the earlier 48-value baseline. It supersedes the initial refusal of RTX's 10M
difference. No balancing plug is introduced.

#### Measurement before the rule

All **105 retained snapshots** were inspected, including the 103 companies,
unknown-security control and extra QQQ control. The census uses each balance
family's untouched vendor `data.raw` observations, not the enriched rows: SEC
completion can already have replaced a vendor total and made a comparison look
exact. There are **3,357** finite nonnegative vendor total/current/noncurrent/lease
quadruples. Of these, **1,057 observations across 63 symbols and 903
symbol-period ends** independently establish the current/noncurrent borrowing
and lease scopes in the same filing, instant, issuer and currency before the
numerical total test. Annual and quarterly observations remain separate: their
provider components can differ even for the same date. The other **2,300**
quadruples lack this independent component-scope proof and cannot gain scope
from a small numerical difference. The unknown/ETF controls provide no eligible
borrowing composition. Collapse, interest plausibility, cash and other admission
checks remain separate from this scope census.

The scratch diagnostic copied the pre-review admission code, recorded only
after its borrowing/lease scope checks, and bypassed the total equality only
for measurement. It never supplied those diagnostic results to Stage B.
No fair value, target, composite or price was used to select the threshold.
Relative difference is `abs(vendor total - vendor component sum) /
max(abs(vendor total), abs(vendor component sum))`; two zeros agree exactly.

The small-difference cluster ends at **0.205050%** (AEP); the next scoped
observation is **0.866513%** (MRK). A simple **0.5%** boundary lies in that
observed gap. Removing RTX leaves both endpoints and the selected boundary
unchanged. The unproved raw pairs are reported for completeness, not used to
turn ambiguous scopes into eligible ones. This is an operational materiality
allowance from a finite sample, not proof that any specific discrepancy was
rounding or reclassification, and not an estimate of a universal error rate.

#### Final admission and disclosure

At or below **0.5% of the larger absolute observation**, use the independently
reconciled components, including any separately proved lease completion. Do
not retain the vendor total merely to preserve its number. The basis prints
both the original vendor total and its original component sum, explicitly calls
the minor difference a qualification rather than filed equality, and says
that reconciled components are used with no balancing plug. The accepted
comparison stays on the calculation row and is re-emitted in one bounded
manifest entry per company even when acquisition completed the row before
Stage B. Raw vendor observations and stored reports remain immutable.

Above 0.5%, debt and net debt remain withheld and the refusal names both
amounts and their percentage difference. There is no absolute monetary floor.
The allowance applies only to the total-versus-components comparison, in both
the older noncurrent-lease completion and broader D-202 completion paths. It
does not relax individual filed lease identities, current-debt overlap checks,
filed/issuer/currency identity, absent maturity splits or independent
collapse/plausibility/cash refusals. The 237M MRK historical difference stays
above the band; it cannot be inserted as missing borrowing.

An old refusal created solely by the vendor-total/component-sum guard may be
re-evaluated against its retained original vendor observation, including beside
an already sourced noncurrent component. That candidate is never admitted by
itself: the same-filing completion and current scope must succeed first. Only
that refusal and net-debt refusals directly dependent on it can clear; an
independent cash refusal still withholds net debt. The older completion path
cannot extend the minor band to a positive vendor current-debt amount for
which no filed current scope is established.

The final census therefore excludes three observations that the legacy path
had retained with an explicitly unverified positive vendor current amount.
One is FIGR at 2026-03-31: vendor total **1,322.541M** versus component sum
**1,323.907M** differs by **0.103179%**, but its **1,057.790M** current debt
has no compatible recognized current-borrowing tag in the retained facts.
The **10.790M** next-fiscal-bucket amount and **44.053M** remainder-of-year
amount are not a current carrying-debt reconciliation. The small total
difference cannot establish that scope. FIGR remains withheld; the initial
diagnostic classification treating its legacy path as fully proved was
corrected before the final census. This does not change either endpoint of
the observed gap or the selected 0.5% threshold.

RTX's observed **38,884M** total versus **38,874M** original component sum
is **0.025718%**. The completed calculation uses **38,874M**: current financing
5,889M + noncurrent financing 31,490M + the disclosed noncurrent operating
lease portion 1,495M. That proved operating portion then cancels, leaving
**37,379M** financing debt under the house convention. The missing current
operating maturity stays unknown; no earlier period's maturity is imported.
A complete lease-inclusive total remains unavailable. Finance leases not
separately material remains an explicit assumption, never a filed zero.

### Review corrections before merge

Pull request review found two defects in the completion path, both corrected
with tests that failed first:

1. **Current finance leases inside `DebtCurrent`.** When `DebtCurrent` equals the
   pure current debt plus the current finance lease to the tolerance, that lease
   is inside the aggregate and is already counted in the finance total. The pure
   amount is kept, so the lease counts once. With 4M pure current debt, 5M
   `DebtCurrent`, 100M noncurrent, 20M operating and 6M finance leases (1M
   current), total debt is 130M, not 131M. A `DebtCurrent` that exceeds the pure
   amount by anything else remains the inclusive line.
2. **Vendor zero borrowings beside instrument-level debt.** The zero-borrowing
   rule also scans every supported instrument family: notes, loans, secured,
   convertible and revolver, noncurrent and current, plus notes-and-loans, the
   combined debt total and the instrument aggregate. A positive amount in any of
   them keeps the refusal. Explicit zeros still pass. The undisclosed-lease-zero
   path applies the same check to the current instrument families.

Replay and acquisition-order comparison on all 105 frozen inputs show no change
in any company's output, so these corrections alter no value in this panel.


## D-206 - Multi-class share economics (2026-11-05)

**Final rules.** Complete same-date cover counts require affirmative current
equal rights, or one current per-share rate applied to a coordinated class
list. A shared rate proves dividend parity only, not liquidation parity.
Historical/conditional payments and mere class mentions do not qualify.
Conversion alone supports only the disclosed small-class exception: the
unquoted class converts one-for-one into the bound reference class, with
assumed units plus voting-only exclusions at most 0.5% of reference shares.
This limits count inclusion/exclusion sensitivity to one part in 200 at fixed
common equity; it does not bound unknown preferences, EV or WACC.

All retained issuer/accession-bound sections within 400 days are considered,
including Item 1A and separate statement text. The conversion source uses that
same window. A contradiction is a named class entitlement with negation,
relative amount or priority/preference, or an unequal explicit per-share rate
for a recognized common payment period. Refusals quote the actual evidence.
Complete denial clauses prevent prefix-only false alarms. No sentence-specific
anaphora rule assigns a class from an unbound voting label. This is a limited
grammar, not complete legal-language recognition.

Statement checks accept equity/capital-stock headings without colons and
issued-only rows. Missing issued/outstanding classes and positive-cover/zero-
statement conflicts refuse before admission. Participation-only admission
requires a readable statement inventory; missing retained text is not proof
of agreement. Unmapped cover labels are not asserted to be omitted shares.
Voting-only exclusion still requires an unconditional denial, no retained
economic grant, and the aggregate size cap. Dates, splits and independent
diluted-average admission remain required. Member-name decoding is shared.

Reader text uses Class A/B labels and plain counts. The conversion explanation
appears at fair value, DCF and targets; WACC has a short caveat. Generic multiples
and share-count notes do not repeat the paragraph or claim proven equal rights.

**Evidence and limits.** CMCSA retains the conversion exception: 9,444,375 B /
3,541,561,960 A = 0.2667%, about $0.1222 nominal sensitivity at fixed equity
at $45.81. Its trailing figure includes Versant and Sky Germany until separation.
UPS uses affirmative current equality and remains withheld for NCI profit
allocation. SHOP's conditional $33.37 calculation is unchanged, but the frozen
input lacks a readable balance-sheet class inventory; the fail-closed rule
withholds it. Participation and the one non-economic Founder Share do not
replace that missing check. General perimeter disclosure is a separate task.

The measurement-only reviewer set yields 18/25 must-refuse detections, zero
false alarms on 12 benign sentences, and zero false parity on 10 traps. Seven
held-out misses remain reported, without fitting new patterns to them. Across
119 retained sections (9,606,222 characters) for 18 issuers, only 15 issuers
have two mapped common-class labels: 99 sections are eligible for the
contradiction measure. Its one hit is Berkshire's real 1:1,500 rights, already
represented by supported weights; there are no false hits. F, BF.B and EXPE
are unmeasured by this guard, not negative results. META's 10-K is included.
No whole retained text was available for the prior 15 outside-panel issuers.

The 105-input replay and acquisition-order simulation agree without input
mutation. Final available values are 56/103 companies (main 55, pre-review 57),
with five outside-domain, 42 suppressed and two unchanged instrument controls.
SHOP loses the two valuation signals whose admission lacked the statement
check; no signal is lost against main. CMCSA's two valuation signals and UPS's
ROIC/WACC spread remain gained. No other financial numerical outcome changes.

**Release.** Advance `STAGE_B_IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION`, `FAIR_VALUE_METHOD_VERSION`,
`SCENARIO_TARGET_METHOD_VERSION` and `PAYLOAD_VERSION` at integration. No version
constant or stored report is changed here. Existing adapters remain supported.
Revenue, margins, balance-row admission and general perimeter-change handling
remain outside this branch. Commits stay local without push, PR or merge.

**Pull request review.** Two further corrections: a sentence stating that a class has dividend, distribution or liquidation rights that are not equal to, or differ from, another class now counts as a conflict, while a voting difference does not; and stated per-share dividends are compared per economic unit, so a dividend matching a supported class weight such as 1:1,500 is not a conflict, and one that does not match refuses.

## D-207 - Balance rows that do not add up (2026-11-05)

**Rule.** Compare original vendor rows in date order with the latest accepted
same-issuer/currency row. For receivables, inventory, net PP&E and long-term
investments, a material line exceeds 1% of prior assets and collapses below 20%
of its prior value. At least two lines, or the sole material class, must collapse;
their combined loss exceeds 5% of prior assets and total assets retain at least
80%. Unclassified residual growth absorbing 80% of that loss, an unexplained gap
above 1% after a near-total breakdown collapse, or a negative current-asset
offset corroborates incompleteness. Accounted classified presentations remain
admitted. Liquid growth explains the loss only without a negative offset.
Null/absent lines count as empty. Thresholds are independent of valuation.

A failing balance stays if available same-date, same-currency filed evidence
corroborates assets, equity, nonzero book adjustments and every liquid amount
that grew, within existing rounding agreement and compatible filing provenance.
A negative current-asset offset prohibits that override. This **keeps the
existing row**; it constructs no replacement or field splice. Without proof,
use the latest remaining balance until the vendor corrects its observation.
Rows already sourced from SEC statements, including whole replacements inside
vendor families, are exempt from the vendor check. No held-for-sale field branch
is needed; filed disposals use the same corroboration rule.

Income and cash-flow cores are checked independently of balance or timestamp.
After a populated material prior core, all components at or below 1% of the
largest absolute prior component, profit or revenue are empty/near-zero evidence.
Income checks cost, gross profit and operating income; cash flow checks operating,
investing and financing subtotals. Current TTM windows refuse rather than shift.
Specific observations are excluded, preserving complete same-date siblings,
original evidence and plain dated gaps. Consecutive failures never validate each
other. Ordinary field-level scope refusals remain in force.

The same admission view covers calculations, peer comparisons, AI extracts,
full/data-only reports, charts, direct filing disclosures and direct market data.
Dependent provider EV rows are excluded with rejected balances. Both envelope
dates and the observation-date map follow retained rows. The timing helper gets
the view from report roots; source facts get the admitted payload. No other
production reader publishes raw statement rows. Validation, source-manifest and
snapshot evidence intentionally retain original observations; saved reports
remain immutable. Peers lack retained companyfacts, so a collapse has no filing
override: use an older admitted balance, or refuse if existing date/scope checks
fail. Their incomplete current income window is not shifted backwards.

The checks read a copy of each raw observation under the provider's numeric rule, so
a vendor amount sent as text is judged like the admitted row. The raw evidence stays
untouched. An excluded current income quarter refuses the subject's and each peer's
trailing earnings comparison instead of shifting it to older quarters, unless a
complete same-date observation stayed.

**Census.** All 105 inputs: 3,367 vendor balance rows and 6,748 flow rows; no
annual observation fails. Exactly ten September 30, 2026 observations trigger the
raw check. Their final treatment is:

## D-205 - Statement text that fails no longer passes silently (2026-11-04)

### Failure and rule

IBM's latest saved 10-Q reproduced an 18-character statement excerpt. Its TOC
uses full item titles with linked statement and notes children. The item-only
TOC parser did not assign item numbers to those full titles; title navigation
closed Item 1 at its first child. The stub redirect then selected the notes
because their title contains the financial-statements synonym. Acquisition
accepted the tiny prefix before those genuine notes as statement text.

Keep existing substantive financial slices unchanged. When a financial slice
has genuine notes but no proved statement rows, retry bounded item headings
and full-titled parent-item anchors. Child statement/note links do not close
that parent; the next item or part does. Accept a recovery only when its notes
interval is byte-identical to the original interval. This prevents a repeated
page heading from silently losing later notes. The header retry selects the
last candidate enclosing that complete interval, rather than a running header
inside it. An uncertain retry leaves the
genuine notes available and records a separate statement-text gap.

All domestic statement-prefix paths, including annual-index redirects, require
at least two recognizable comparative monetary rows in the retained excerpt.
This is an extraction check, not a debt-admission rule. The 12,000-character
cap remains. When long front matter consumes that cap, a following statement
heading with nearby monetary rows can supply the excerpt instead. Headings,
company metadata, contents lists, audit prose and exhibits alone cannot pass.
An unproved prefix is absent, carries `statementsTextGap`, and contributes a
warn-level `edgar.tenKNotes.statementsText(SYMBOL)` or quarterly equivalent to
the bundle's acquisition gaps. The source manifest continues to describe
available sources; no successful source is fabricated for missing text.

The full census also exposed two short Other Information failures: INTC's
page-list mini contents and MS's group anchor landing in Legal Proceedings.
Page-only contents without a body now fail the stub check even above the
short-section minimum. A title-only group target whose body proves a different
child title is excluded from both initial navigation and the mini-TOC retry.
Genuine short narrative, absence statements and narrative page references keep
their existing treatment.

### Frozen evidence and scope

The audit reads all 105 round-two snapshots using a read-only, file-must-exist
SQLite connection. Saved SEC primary documents and the prior audit cache are
the only filing sources; no live SEC retry is attempted after the recorded
403. A normal-acquisition replay uses the saved filing identities and HTML,
empty unrelated financial inputs and offline transports. It compares main's
producer with this branch and compares the main replay against the frozen
strings. Direct string equality supplements SHA-256 for unchanged slots.
Full extracted passages, first/last passages, lengths, found status, hashes,
every threshold candidate and every changed slot remain under the ignored
`tmp/ibm-statement-text/` directory; no filing text is committed.

The initial stored census has 930 present or explicitly collected slots, 802
successful. Nineteen of 142 statement prefixes are only 18–61 characters:
NVDA annual; WMT, MCD, TSLA quarterly; MS annual and quarterly; TRV annual;

SPG, CMCSA, RTX, MMM, CSCO, CRM, UBER, BF.B and ASTS. Availability and length

`7102a583` in `6dfaf16b`, retaining both documentation sides. On this merged

27 defective prefixes recover substantive statements, 11 become explicit

## D-263 - Cash-use conventions, declared definitions and citation coordinates (2026-11-13)

**Principles and evidence.** P19 reserves contradicted for value/direction conflicts;
P21 preserves stored bytes. LLY #63's two unsigned cash-capex amounts match their
negative-for-outflow source, and its standardized FCF must not bind to the CFO
operand named inside its definition. The 33 rejected legacy citations are actually
score operand coordinates containing array indexes. They were legitimately written
as typed coordinates. Their false warning contributed one of 13 confidence-cap
warnings; removing it leaves 12, still medium. No stored report/database is changed.

**Final rule after independent review.** The initially submitted implementation was
too permissive in the eight cases below. Those declarations/shortcuts are removed;
this section supersedes the earlier D-263 description, not P19's refusal rules.
D-160 and D-187 remain marked Revised by D-263.

1. Outflow metadata means **negative-for-outflow by construction**, not merely a
   payment-like label. Only the admitted statement capitalExpenditure and
   commonStockRepurchased fields and current cash-capex record declare it.
   acquisitionCashPaid is positive-for-payment and negative-for-net-inflow, so it
   retains signed matching. Unallocated acquisition payments, finance-lease
   principal and shareholder distributions are positive/null constructions and
   carry no negative-for-outflow tag. Regression tests retain the net-inflow sign.
2. Uncited declared outflows never use the label-rebuild fallback. Absolute-value
   display is allowed only after the complete clause validates directly. Opposing
   or unbound prose (positive, proceeds, refund, received, source of cash, provided,
   added, reversal) cannot become confirmed by deleting words. Explicit plus,
   wrong values and true signed-delta direction conflicts retain their refusals.
3. Parentheses are masked only on exact normalized equality with a definition
   explicitly declared by a candidate producer. No less/plus/minus/over word
   heuristic identifies a formula. Incidental asides keep the original matching
   behavior and true value conflicts. Unknown/reversed formulas, wrong subjects,
   dates, units, currencies and bases remain unverified or contradicted as before.
4. The legacy reader exempts only score operands with the current writer's dotted
   coordinate form containing a numeric [index]. Empty, malformed, multiply dated
   and conflicting-date citation tokens still become unsupported:legacy-citation,
   with the original warning. Ordinary citations retain their compatibility parser.
5. The vendor EBITDA fallback really exists. computeCapital now emits affirmative
   ebitdaComputed proof only when EBIT plus cash-flow D&A built the figure, and the
   actual current snapshot carries that proof. Only this path declares the EBITDA
   component definition; vendor or old cached results without proof do not.
6. The old net-debt guard really read the annual object. The definition now requires
   the emitted current value to match its own current debtBridge lease-inclusive
   net debt, without excluded equity securities. Different current perimeters fail
   closed regardless of whether the annual perimeter qualifies.
7. Producer-label parentheses can be accounting qualifiers. Labels are never
   stripped to create equivalent metric readings or to remove operand checks.
   A margin labelled adjusted/less stock compensation cannot prove an unqualified
   margin. Explicit prose definitions remain separate from required record labels.
8. Nine cash-use field names were inert; taxes/interest are normally positive.
   The declaration list is trimmed to the two actual negative-for-outflow fields.
   No speculative future field declarations or new prompt records are introduced.

**Breadth and controls.** The rule is issuer-independent across annual, quarter,
YTD and trailing windows, domestic/foreign filers and company routes. It applies
only where a producer establishes the sign convention and formula. A positive
payment amount normally matches as positive; a net inflow must retain its sign.
Tests cover industrial annual cash capex, bank repurchases, foreign trailing capex,
utility YTD repurchases, and controls where the rule must not fire. Supported
component definitions cover FCF, net debt, computed EBITDA, margins and coverage;
unknown bases and missing construction proof remain verification gaps. No new
currency normalizer, tolerance, day band, status or timeout is introduced.

### Second independent review (2026-11-14)

A second review by a different model family confirmed the eight earlier
findings fixed and found two cases where reader prose that main marks as a
conflict was only left unverified. Both came from skipping the label rebuild
entirely for a declared cash outflow or a clause holding a declared definition.
The rebuild now runs for those records but can only report a value conflict; it
never confirms. Under a found definition only the record that declares that
definition is read, so a definition cannot make a different metric the subject.
"Margin (gross profit divided by revenue) was 22.34%" against a 40% gross margin
is again a conflict, and a different amount stated for a declared outflow is
again a conflict. Known limit, kept on the cautious side (P19: doubt means
unverified): uncited prose that states the same magnitude as a declared outflow
but calls it a source of cash is left unverified, not marked as a conflict,
because the rebuilt label no longer carries the clause's direction words. It is
never confirmed. No stored-company figure changes: across the 17 regression
cases and the two Eli Lilly rebuilds no numeric Stage B leaf differs from main.
